versions.changelog:
Initial release: expert, brand-neutral assistance for refrigerator buyers

- Guides users through detailed questions on household size, kitchen space, climate, power, and usage habits
- Delivers structured, prioritized refrigerator spec recommendations based on user context (capacity, type, efficiency, climate class, compressor type, and more)
- Provides up to five real product examples matched to the user's needs (without brand or marketing bias)
- Ensures region-aware advice, including climate and voltage stability considerations
- Avoids troubleshooting, maintenance, or post-purchase queries—focus is strictly purchase guidance
